name: theming
description: Theming, split on PIPELINE STAGE first (intake -> declaration -> generation -> contrast), with producer/consumer as the direction each stage faces and per-artefact specialisation last. The owner chose that axis on 2026-09-20 — "1 + 2, then specialized to 3" — and the ordering matters more than the names: going artefact-first would duplicate intake and contrast into every surface, which is the shape that put the scrim rule in one skill's prose and let it be rediscovered rather than read. Before this package existed, theming was spread across schemas/themes.ts, schemas/theme.ts, schemas/landing-sticky.ts, the generated docs-ui.css, themes:css, check:theme-art, the scrim rules and the avatar crop boxes, with no directory naming itself as theming. Four rounds of "still not image" had one cause and it was a theming fact with nowhere to live. Bean `1hvo`. `theme-art-intake` MOVED here from folio-core and kept its name, because ids are stable across a relocation while paths are not; `theme-ui-review` deliberately did not, because it is a UI review skill for which theming is one subject rather than the subject.
